name: Drunken Broster layer
note: A per-bro layer, meant to be passed after the base list: capture_animations with states ["base-states.json", "drunken-broster.json"]. Entries replace the base entry of the same name outright, so special_new here is the whole entry, not a patch over the base one.

states.name: special_new
states.knownMismatch: usingSpecialFrame 7 writes column 7 and then StopUsingSpecial clears usingSpecial and re-enters ChangeFrame (DrunkenBroster.AnimateSpecial's usingSpecialFrame >= 7 branch, DrunkenBroster.StopUsingSpecial), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 7
states.note: Replaces the base special_new entry: DrunkenBroster.AnimateSpecial overrides TestVanDammeAnim.AnimateSpecial and is driven by its own DrunkenBroster.usingSpecialFrame counter (incremented from DrunkenBroster.IncreaseFrame), not by frame, so the base entry's step field addresses nothing here. The !DrunkenBroster.wasDrunk arm is DrunkenBroster.usingSpecialFrame * spritePixelWidth at spritePixelHeight * 8, so row 8 columns 0-7 on the main sheet. DrunkenBroster.usingSpecialFrame 6 calls UseSpecial, whose override (DrunkenBroster.UseSpecial) runs DrunkenBroster.BecomeDrunk and swaps the renderer's material to the drunk sheet: with the harness's default suppression that call is patched out and every frame stays on the main sheet, so run with --allow-side-effects to see the swap as a change of texId from frame 6 onward. Invulnerable, invulnerableTime and speed are pinned, so each step starts from them whatever DrunkenBroster.AnimateSpecial wrote on the last. after calls DrunkenBroster.BecomeSober because the real DrunkenBroster.BecomeDrunk registers him with DrunkenCameraManager (its last statement), a static list the restore between states cannot reach; on a baseline run it changes nothing that restore does not put back.

states.name: special_new_sober
states.knownMismatch: usingSpecialFrame 10 writes column 10 and then StopUsingSpecial clears usingSpecial and re-enters ChangeFrame (DrunkenBroster.AnimateSpecial's usingSpecialFrame >= 10 branch, DrunkenBroster.StopUsingSpecial), so the captured cell for the last step is the post-cancel pose rather than column 10
states.note: The DrunkenBroster.wasDrunk arm of DrunkenBroster.AnimateSpecial: DrunkenBroster.usingSpecialFrame * spritePixelWidth at spritePixelHeight * 10, so row 10 columns 0-10. before calls DrunkenBroster.BecomeDrunk, so the state starts on the drunk sheet, and DrunkenBroster.usingSpecialFrame 6 calls DrunkenBroster.UseSpecial -> DrunkenBroster.BecomeSober, which swaps the material back to the normal sheet, so with --allow-side-effects frames 0-5 carry the drunk sheet's texId and 6-10 the normal one. Under the default suppression every frame stays on the drunk sheet. after calls DrunkenBroster.BecomeSober for the DrunkenCameraManager registration, which the restore between states cannot reach.

states.name: running_holding_item
states.note: The base running body frames walked with a melee item in hand. before calls DrunkenBroster.SwitchToHeldItem, which sets DrunkenBroster.holdingItem, moves DrunkenBroster.chosenItem into DrunkenBroster.heldItem, activates the DrunkenBroster.gunSpriteMelee object, hides the original gun object and repoints gunSprite at DrunkenBroster.gunSpriteMeleeSprite, whose material is the 512x768 gunSpriteMelee.png cut into 32x32 cells (set up in DrunkenBroster.Start); after calls DrunkenBroster.ClearHeldItem, which puts the original gun sprite back. The body cells are the base running ones: DrunkenBroster.ChangeFrame forwards to base.ChangeFrame when health <= 0 or chimneyFlip, and otherwise dispatches on DrunkenBroster.attackStationary, DrunkenBroster.attackUpwards, DrunkenBroster.attackDownwards and DrunkenBroster.attackForwards first, so the setup pins all four false and it forwards to base.ChangeFrame either way, where TestVanDammeAnim.ChangeFrame's Running arm -> AnimateRunning reaches DrunkenBroster.AnimateActualNewRunningFrames, which writes frame % 8 at spritePixelHeight * 2 -- main row 2 columns 0-7. expectGun holds the gun cells, so a DrunkenBroster.SwitchToHeldItem that stopped repointing gunSprite fails the state rather than passing on an unchanged body row: DrunkenBroster.AnimateActualNewRunningFrames calls SetGunSprite(frame % 8, 1) while gunFrame <= 0 and !doingMelee, and the override (DrunkenBroster.SetGunSprite) adds (int)DrunkenBroster.heldItem * 2 to the row, so with DrunkenBroster.heldItem Bottle (= 3, DrunkenBroster.MeleeItem) the lower-left pixel is gunSpritePixelHeight * (1 + 1 + 6) which is melee-sheet row 8, columns 0-7. gunFrame is pinned to 0 so that branch is taken on every step. The melee gun object is drawn on every step whatever active state it inherited from the original in DrunkenBroster.SwitchToHeldItem: ChangeFrame calls ActivateGun on the swapped-in gunSprite whenever health > 0 and neither usingSpecial nor doingMelee (TestVanDammeAnim.ChangeFrame, TestVanDammeAnim.ActivateGun), all three pinned here, and AnimateRunning's last arm calls it again. Bottle rather than ExplosiveBarrel because a barrel arms a five-second timer in DrunkenBroster.SwitchToHeldItem that DrunkenBroster.Update runs down through DrunkenBroster.RunBarrelEffects (DrunkenBroster.Update's DrunkenBroster.holdingItem && ExplosiveBarrel check). The DrunkenBroster.holdingItem requirement skips a bro already holding at sweep start rather than handing DrunkenBroster.ClearHeldItem an item he is meant to keep.

states.name: idle_firing
states.note: Restates the base idle_firing: DrunkenBroster.RunGun steps gunFrame but draws DrunkenBroster.SetGunSprite(0, 0) on every tick, so his gun holds row 1 column 0 through the recoil instead of walking it.
